blocks.text: Numbers 15 contains 41 verses. It opens with: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying, It concludes with: I am Jehovah your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am Jehovah your God. Supplied contextual evidence for this passage adds: Proposed maps of the wilderness route should label uncertain site identifications rather than presenting a single itinerary reconstruction as established.
